success_patterns: When required travel or hotel dates are missing, ask for those dates rather than inferring them from an event or general trip context.
Apply a new flight-class preference independently to each affected cached itinerary leg; do not apply traveler counts to flight searches.
Reuse cached results for follow-ups and avoid repeating completed work or retrieving unrelated results.
